review.notes:
Earlier transitions are cosmetic and precede the baseline's recorded version: v0 (SD10-EN031, 2007-01-17) -> v1 (DPYG-EN030 1st Edition, 2009-07-07) -> v2 (LCYW-EN101, 2012-09-29) -> v3 (BP02-EN188, 2013-06-28) only move the "(This card is also still a Trap Card.)" clause, drop "After activation", and reword the Gadget requirement ("are all face-up on your side of the field" -> "you control"); all keep "ATK becomes 3000" and all require face-up Gadgets, which both scripts check with a face-up filter. v1 is the text in force at the Edison snapshot (2010-04-24) and is behaviourally identical to v3, which is what the baseline's cdb text matches (it differs from v3 only by the article "a" before "Green Gadget"; packet ratio 0.9959). The card postdates the GOAT snapshot (first TCG printing 2007-01-17). Apparent date conflict at v4, resolved: the row bundles card number DPYG-EN030 again, but as the Unlimited Edition reprint distributed in Duelist Pack: Yugi & Kaiba Special Edition (2013-10-25), not the 2009 1st Edition; v2 (2012-09-29) and v3 (2013-06-28) still carry the old text, so the lineage ordering supports the 2013 dating the packet used. Trailing cosmetic changes v4 -> v5 (YGLD-ENC39, 2015-11-12) -> v6 (OP11-EN021, 2019-08-15) are Machine-Type -> Machine and Trap Card -> Trap only; not recorded as changes. The packet's second upstream code, 511015121 "Stronghold the Moving Fortress (Manga)", is a manga-only card with a different effect (negate a declared direct attack, then Special Summon itself face-up as a non-Trap Effect Monster) scripted under unofficial/; it is not a historical version of the TCG card and is not folded in.

Round 037 (2026-09-29). Checked against period rulings: the differences the functional transition claims were searched for in the Konami-hosted UDE card FAQ (2008-12), the 2005 UDE card rulings page, Konami's errata lists, rulebooks and per-set ruling documents, and the archived UDE judge-list threads Yugipedia points to (the transition's rulings_check; docs/research/text-only-errata-audit.md, Stronghold the Moving Fortress). No period ruling in the corpus settles a claimed difference, so the functional call stands unchanged (`unresolved` at both snapshots); the search is recorded in the check. Verdicts: [event] d1 unresolved at Edison, unresolved at Tengu; d2 unresolved at Edison, unresolved at Tengu.

effective.basis: TCG release of the first printing carrying the errata'd text (DPYG-EN030 Unlimited Edition, distributed in Duelist Pack: Yugi & Kaiba Special Edition)

event.historical_text: Special Summon this card in Defense Position as an Effect Monster (Machine-Type/EARTH/Level 4/ATK 0/DEF 2000). (This card is also still a Trap Card.) While you control a "Green Gadget", "Red Gadget", and "Yellow Gadget", this card's ATK becomes 3000.
event.modern_text: Special Summon this card in Defense Position as an Effect Monster (Machine-Type/EARTH/Level 4/ATK 0/DEF 2000). (This card is also still a Trap Card.) While you control a "Green Gadget", "Red Gadget", and "Yellow Gadget", this card gains 3000 ATK.
event.summary: Functional erratum: "this card's ATK becomes 3000" became "this card gains 3000 ATK". The pre-errata script registers the three-Gadget effect as EFFECT_SET_ATTACK_FINAL with value 3000, so while the Gadgets are face-up the ATK is fixed at 3000 and every other ATK modifier is overridden; the modern script registers EFFECT_UPDATE_ATTACK 3000, an additive boost that stacks with other ATK changes. The two scripts are otherwise identical (same activation/Special Summon target check, same TYPE_TRAP+TYPE_EFFECT monster attribute, same face-up Gadget condition).

rulings_check.difference: Era 'this card's ATK becomes 3000' sets the ATK to 3000 while the three Gadgets are face-up, overriding ATK modifiers applied earlier; modern 'this card gains 3000 ATK' adds 3000 on top of every other modifier. The variant script's EFFECT_SET_ATTACK_FINAL also ignores ATK modifiers applied after the Gadget effect begins to apply, whereas period rulings on other 'ATK becomes' effects say later modifiers adjust from the new value.
